patterns.template: One locked-camera documentary interview take from the supplied frame, same {subject}, face, hair, {wardrobe}, background and {lighting}. Preserve the reference skin texture without retouching. The subject remains seated with settled shoulders, hands resting in their lap below frame. Eyes stay on one interviewer {gaze_direction}; an occasional natural blink and small mouth movements accompany speech. Understated matter-of-fact delivery. Begin speaking immediately: "{product_named_dialogue}". Finish the sentence once, then close the lips and listen quietly. No shoulder shrug, sideways glance, head sway, exaggerated eyebrows, zoom, cuts, music, captions or logos.
patterns.finding: One Kling revision started speech at 0.00s versus 1.26s and showed more settled sampled shoulders/gaze.
limits: Unseeded trial; prompt effect is confounded with randomness
Speech ended at 3.48s, leaving a long pause
Raised eyebrows and smooth skin remain
Hands are not visible, so hand realism is untested
Use a measured trim point; never assume generated timing matches the prompt
patterns.do_not_repeat: Do not add more micro-actions to repair overacting without a specific hypothesis.

patterns.method: Choose a settled decoded exit frame after speech, record source/time/hash, condition the next shot on that image, and cut the outgoing take at the same timestamp.
patterns.finding: Prior Crew pilot head-region seam diagnostic improved from 7.35x for the shared-anchor control to 1.19x with the exit frame.
limits: Pixel change is a seam diagnostic, not a realism measure
Check transcript because words may change
